relevance.rationale: Article 5 of RIMS Kokyuroku 1172 (2000), pp. 70-79 (H. Murakami): 'optimistic' asymptotics of the WRT SU(2) invariants for the CLOSED 3-manifolds obtained from the figure-eight knot by integral Dehn surgeries p = 0..10, extracting volumes and Chern-Simons invariants of those closed manifolds, with a conjecture that the same holds generally. The corpus's figure-eight work is entirely on the COMPLEMENT (Vol + i CS of 4_1, the Kashaev/colored-Jones asymptotic, the Ohtsuki tower, the 3D-index of m004); it carries no surgered-closed-manifold object and no 'optimistic limit' method -- greps for 'optimistic' in content/ and docs/ return nothing. So the surgery table is same-field data with no consumer. Recorded as tangential, scope-(a). Worth noting for the merge: uploads/1172-1..5.pdf are five articles of the same Kokyuroku volume, fetched together; see the corpus note below.

proposedActions.rationale: Closed surgered manifolds are outside the corpus's 4_1-complement scope; no block or script consumes surgery Vol/CS values.
